headline: LPG tanker catches fire in Strait of Hormuz following reported projectile strike
summary: The crew of an LPG tanker abandoned ship after the vessel was reportedly struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. The incident follows a surge in attacks around the strategic energy shipping route.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most critical maritime chokepoints for crude oil, condensate, and liquefied petroleum gas shipments.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz raise supply disruption risks for global crude markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical strikes on energy vessels in key shipping corridors heighten supply disruption risks, pushing energy benchmark prices higher.
